# HikingGuy

> > Expert hiking guides, gear reviews, and trail-tested recommendations from professional hiking guide Cris Hazzard.

HikingGuy.com is a comprehensive hiking resource created by Cris Hazzard featuring detailed trail guides with turn-by-turn directions, in-depth gear and GPS device reviews, and practical hiking skills education. The site emphasizes field-tested recommendations and includes interactive maps, GPX files, and video walkthroughs for iconic hikes across the United States.

## Key Topics

- Hiking Guides
- Trail Reviews
- Garmin GPS Devices
- Hiking Safety
- Gear Reviews
- Bucket List Hikes
- GPS Navigation
- Garmin inReach
- Mt. Whitney
- Hiking Skills
- State High Points
- Product Comparisons
- Cris Hazzard
- Video Walkthroughs
- Trail Maps & GPX

## Hiking Trails & Guides

- [Hiking Trails & Guides for Iconic Hikes](https://hikingguy.com/hike/hiking-trails): Main hiking trails hub with guides, maps, GPX files for iconic hikes
- [Bucket List Hikes: Best Hikes in the US (Turn-by-Turn Guides)](https://hikingguy.com/guides/bucket-list-hikes): Turn-by-turn guides for bucket list hikes like The Narrows and Rim-to-Rim
- [Mt Whitney Hike Guide 2026: Permits, Training, Route, Safety](https://hikingguy.com/hiking-trails/mt-whitney-hike): Complete Mt. Whitney guide with permits, training plans, and safety info
- [How to Hike Guadalupe Peak (Guadalupe Mountains NP)](https://hikingguy.com/hiking-trails/guadalupe-peak-hike-guide): Turn-by-turn guide for hiking Guadalupe Peak in Texas with videos

## Hiking Gear & Equipment Reviews

- [Hiking Gear & Tech](https://hikingguy.com/hiking-gear): Primary hiking gear and tech review section covering Garmin and equipment
- [Best Hiking Gear 2026: What I Actually Use (No Sponsorships)](https://hikingguy.com/best-hiking-gear): Trail-tested gear recommendations including shoes, packs, and Garmin devices
- [Garmin eTrex Touch Review: Worth It?](https://hikingguy.com/hiking-gear/garmin-etrex-touch-review): Field-tested review of Garmin eTrex Touch GPS device performance

## GPS & Navigation Technology

- [Best Hiking GPS 2026 - Trail Tested](https://hikingguy.com/guides/best-hiking-gps): Guide and reviews for best hiking GPS units including Garmin GPSMAP
- [Best Garmin inReach Devices for 2026: Trail Tested](https://hikingguy.com/guides/best-garmin-inreach): Trail-tested comparison of Garmin inReach satellite communicators
- [Garmin inReach Mini 2 vs Mini 3: Should You Upgrade?](https://hikingguy.com/hiking-gear/garmin-inreach-mini-2-vs-mini-3): Trail-tested comparison of Garmin inReach Mini satellite communicators
